basic_info.description: Welcome to 937 Russia Ave, a beautifully renovated home where sophistication meets modern convenience. Thoughtfully updated, it features new engineered hardwood floors, upgraded plumbing and electrical systems, and a flexible floorplan designed for comfort. The stylish kitchen boasts sleek cabinetry, smart appliances, and under-cabinet LED lighting, while the bathrooms showcase high-end fixtures and refined finishes. A private guest suite downstairs, complete with a wet bar, offers versatility for hosting or extended stays. Separate furnace systems for both levels ensure year-round comfort.    Enjoy stunning views from the front and back, along with a low-maintenance backyardperfect for relaxing or entertaining. Nestled in the heart of Excelsior, this home offers easy access to freeways and public transit, making commuting a breeze. 937 Russia Ave isn't just a homeit's a lifestyle upgrade.
